task_text: Lemon Harvesting: One lemon and six limes are fixed to the front face of a wall in front of the hovering aerial manipulator, and a grey storage tote sits on a small table against the wall to the robot's left. Harvest the lemon: free it from the wall and get it into the tote. Success needs the lemon's reference point (the base of the fruit) inside the tote's nominal box while the gripper is fully open. Success: Success at a control step when both hold: (1) the lemon's root position (its body origin, at the bottom of the fruit in the lemon's own frame) is inside, bounds inclusive, the world-axis-aligned box container_root + [(-0.20, -0.15, 0), (0.20, 0.15, 0.17)] m, i.e. the tote's nominal 0.40 x 0.30 x 0.17 m size above its bottom-centre root; (2) the gripper width, arm_lfinger_joint + arm_rfinger_joint (each limited to [0.001, 0.045] m, so 0.002 to 0.09 m in total), is > 0.0898 m (gripper_open_threshold): both fingers essentially at their open limit. The lemon need not be at rest and its orientation is not tested; being inside the box at one step is enough. AM-Bench also reports lemon_grasped_and_detached (latched once lemon and tool tip have moved together >= 0.02 m with the gripper closed below 0.05 m and the lemon within 0.12 m of the tool tip) and lemon_delivered_released (the success itself); they are informational only. Evaluated after every control step (decimation 1, so after every 1/120 s physics step) on the simulated state; no hold time is required. The episode terminates at the first step where it holds. Otherwise it is truncated by the time limit: episode_length_s = 30 s, i.e. max_episode_length = 3600 control steps; AM-Bench raises the time-out when episode_length_buf >= max_episode_length - 1, i.e. at the 3599th step.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where AM-Bench's success check holds, when the task's episode length of 30 s of simulated time runs out (AM-Bench's time-out, at control step 3599), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
